profile.headline: Empowering Teams With AI
profile.summary:
Professional goals (written in 2015, still relevant):
- Learn to identify and solve real market needs (as opposed to following the crowd)
- Continuous refinement of work style towards effectiveness and utility. 
- Understand the potential of generative AI as it begins to work.

My career has been focused on developing scalable systems for startups. I have developed open source machine learning packages, released multiple apps across many platforms with widespread usage and helped startups reach product-market fit then scale with demand. I believe in using the technology that is most relevant for the task.

My work at 255labs has been helping startups build and scale novel solutions to real world problems. I have been involved in the backend engineering teams and enjoy heavy technical work as well as working on bigger picture startup issues.

I've had my own open source projects written about in popular development blogs. I've presented on various technologies (node, coffeescript, docker, rnns, gans). In every team I've been a part of, I've been a proponent for adopting new and pertinent technologies.

positions.description: AI development and product development. Deployed custom applications (node, ruby, python) to thousands of daily users. Developed open source libraries. Distributed custom trained models with tens of thousands of downloads. Consulted with multiple early stage startups.

positions.description: Consulted on various initiatives such as: node.js app development, aws infrastructure and AI NLP methods for chatbot enhancements.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Node.js · Linux · Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Natural Language Processing (NLP)

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description: Helped with implementation and product-market search.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Startup Development · Node.js · JavaScript · Linux · Grails

positions.title: Software Architect - Rails API
positions.description:
Coinstar Exchange is a part of Outerwall(OUTR) focused on purchasing gift cards through kiosks in grocery stores (big yellow kiosks).

I built and monitored an API platform used by the kiosks.  The platform is written in Rails and is heavily tested with both unit and integration tests.  Other things introduced so far: StatsD real time graphs on company health, an HTML5 admin interface, machine learning, and production error monitoring.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Ruby · Back-End Web Development · Machine Learning · JavaScript · Ruby on Rails · Linux

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Used grails / javascript to create and deploy custom solutions for ecommerce. Included social media plugin development.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Startup Development · Java · JavaScript · Linux · Grails

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a small team to create many applications related to giftcards and postpaid services.

Automated testing of a socket based application, built various internal tools to help with our process, developed iPhone application, refactoring existing applications, revamping build systems, deploying and monitoring production services, and more.
positions.insights: Skills: iPhone Application Development · Web Services · Java · Linux

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked with a very small team to develop site scrapers for fifty different sites over the course a few months.  We were able to completely automate the testing process and writing a state scraper became a 2 day task from a 1 week task.
positions.insights: Skills: Product Development · Ruby · JavaScript · Linux

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Integral (later acquired by Ascendant) was a consulting company specializing in FileNet enterprise content management and ilog rules consulting. Worked on internal tools and projects related to the ECM field. Java

projects.title: HyperGAN

Open source machine learning package.
It allows anyone to create a generative adversarial network.
Built with python & tensorflow.  Influenced and used by many.

projects.title: Wix Applications
projects.description: A helpful set of widgets for website creators.  These widgets receive over 200,000 hits per month and rising.
